prose.subject: Payment Required: Full Route Analysis Report
prose.body:
Thanks for requesting your detailed logistics analysis from Kestrel Freight. To unlock the full report, please complete the payment below.

Report Contents:
This premium package includes a 48-hour forward-looking risk assessment for your selected freight corridors. It features predictive delay probabilities, fuel cost variance models, and alternative routing suggestions optimized for both speed and carrier reliability. You will also receive a JSON-formatted dataset compatible with your existing TMS integration, allowing you to automate future re-routes based on real-time disruptions.

Pricing:
The total cost for this report is 8182.24 USDC. This amount covers the computational resources used to model complex weather and traffic scenarios, as well as the manual validation performed by our route optimization specialists.

Payment Details:
Please send the exact amount to the following account to activate your download link:
0xc177cd2d06426e309079e3676fc3fff36e0f670d

Once the transaction confirms on the network, your report will be generated and a direct download link will be emailed to you within five minutes. If you encounter any issues with the payment, reply to this message and our support team will assist you promptly.

Thank you for choosing Kestrel Freight for your supply chain intelligence needs.
